name: falsify_truncated_input
description: FALSIFICATION of the verdict, input side. Identical to player_standard_5 except that playback is restricted to the first 7 clip seconds, so the scene opens (skill tab) and never closes: recognition is incomplete, no record.json is written and the capture attempt records no outcome. The runner must not pass it: it must exit 2 with exactly [outcome_unobserved] on clip 0, while the record comparison reports match false against the whole golden. Exit 2 is this scenario's expected result and is not re-run; that a record diff is caught is falsify_wrong_golden's job. sync is off because the annotated stops at frames 161 and 273 lie outside the range and would never fire; record_wait is short because the point is the absence of an outcome, not how long to hope for one.
